name: Countdown Timer
summary: Presentational countdown segments with default, compact inline, and card treatments; calculation and expiration behavior remain outside the source contract.

anatomy.name: number
anatomy.description: Displayed value for one time unit.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible unit label for one value.

variants.name: inline
variants.description: Compact inline value and unit pairs for constrained contexts.

variants.name: cards
variants.description: Segments rendered on padded card surfaces.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive segment sizing supplied by canonical CSS.

states.name: default
states.description: Presentational values supplied by the consuming target.

behavior.name: suppliedValues
behavior.description: The source layer presents values and unit labels supplied by a target; it does not define date math, tick cadence, time zones, synchronization, or expiration behavior.

properties.name: segments
properties.description: Target-supplied repeated value and unit groups.

accessibility: Keep every number associated with a visible or programmatic unit label.
Expose a concise complete time-remaining phrase when visual segmentation would be verbose or ambiguous to assistive technology.
Do not announce every tick through a live region.
The consuming target must define and communicate expiration behavior before treating the countdown as functional.

web.notes: Presentational CSS is implemented; calculation and expiration behavior are unresolved.
